name: Aave Liquidity Agent
description: Manages Aave V3 liquidity positions on Arbitrum. Supply, withdraw, and repay assets on your behalf with configurable safety limits.

run.description: Execute a supply, withdraw, or repay action on Aave V3

permissions.reason: Check your current token balances and collateral ratio before acting
Aave V3 subgraph for live position data and health factor
Submit supply, withdraw, or repay transactions to Aave V3 on your behalf

action.description: Action to perform: supply | withdraw | repay

token.description: Token symbol to act on (e.g. USDC, ETH, WBTC)

amount.description: Amount to supply/withdraw/repay as a decimal string (e.g. '100.00')

wallet_address.description: Wallet address of the position owner

min_health_factor.description: Minimum health factor to maintain — agent refuses if action would drop below this

health_factor_before.description: Aave health factor before the action

health_factor_after.description: Estimated Aave health factor after the action
